generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 16 kWh lithium-ion pack (88 cells; LEV50 -> LEV50N cells from MY2013 at the same capacity), about 3.3-3.6 kW AC on J1772, CHAdeMO DC (about 50 kW class; a US$750 option at launch, standard from MY2014). No pack or charger change during North American sales, so one generation. US: MY2012-2014, 2016, 2017 (EPA has no 2015; discontinued in the US Aug 2017). Canada: MY2012-2017 (NRCan). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mitsubishi_i-MiEV
